fire.name: Temper Flame
fire.flavour: Your fire has learned patience: a steady, even heat instead of a blaze.

fire.name: Searing Brand
fire.flavour: Your fire has learned violence: it jumps to wherever it can hurt.

fire.name: Hearth Ember
fire.flavour: Your fire has learned gentleness: it warms a room and never scorches a meal.

water.name: Mending Tide
water.flavour: Your water has learned to knit rather than to cut.

water.name: Cutting Current
water.flavour: Your water has learned to find the gap in an opponent's guard.

water.name: Steady Irrigant
water.flavour: Your water has learned the rhythm of fields: never too much, never too little.

earth.name: Oreheart Grip
earth.flavour: Your earth has learned the grain of metal before the hammer finds it.

earth.name: Loamkeeper Hand
earth.flavour: Your earth has learned to coax rather than to break.

earth.name: Bulwark Stance
earth.flavour: Your earth has learned to hold a line and not give an inch.

wind.name: Silent Gale
wind.flavour: Your wind has learned to carry no sound at all.

wind.name: Razor Draft
wind.flavour: Your wind has learned to cut on the exhale.

wind.name: Clearing Breath
wind.flavour: Your wind has learned to settle a racing mind as easily as it stirs a storm.

lightning.name: Storm Edge
lightning.flavour: Your lightning has learned to strike before the thought finishes forming.

lightning.name: Arcwright Spark
lightning.flavour: Your lightning has learned to leave a truer line through metal than any chisel.

lightning.name: Quickcast Charge
lightning.flavour: Your lightning has learned to arrive at a technique's end before the casting is done.

qi.name: Still Reservoir
qi.flavour: Your qi has learned to pool deep and calm instead of racing off at the first call.

qi.name: Flowing Form
qi.flavour: Your qi has learned the shortest path between one technique and the next.

qi.name: Warm Current
qi.flavour: Your qi has learned to settle into someone else's body as gently as your own.

mutations.name: Warbrand Forge
mutations.flavour: Your fire has become one thing whether it is folding steel or ending a fight: unforgiving heat with an exact purpose.

mutations.name: Lifeblood Current
mutations.flavour: Your water no longer distinguishes between mending and unmaking a body — it simply understands them both completely.

mutations.name: Worldshaper Hand
mutations.flavour: Ore and soil answer you the same way now: as things waiting to be given a shape.

mutations.name: Stormstalker
mutations.flavour: Silence and violence have become the same motion for you.

mutations.name: Thunderweave
mutations.flavour: Your techniques and your strikes have fused into a single, near-instant reflex.

mutations.name: Unbroken Circuit
mutations.flavour: Stillness and technique have stopped being separate states for you.
